Shiny Days is the "HQ" remake of Summer Days, a spin-off sequel to the original game told from the viewpoint of Setsuna. When Sekai gets sick and asks Setsuna to take over for her at her part-time job, it's the start of something important for Setsuna and Makoto, and for all the School Days characters. It will be a summer no one will forget.  
  
Shiny Days is a massive game with 35+ game endings all brought to you with full motion animation and mosaic-free erotic scenes. In addition to stories with the main game heroines all School Days fans are familiar with, there are many other characters, including minor and side characters from the original game who have well-developed routes now, plus the mothers of several characters and more, all of whom are romanceable characters.

Important:  
1. No need to install; Updated; Content Restore Patch Applied.  
  
2. Fixed bugs:  
 - Minami ending - New ending credits made. Crash is also fixed  
 - Route map nodes fixed and progress percentage recalculated  
 - Missing splash screens added.  
 - Story Route bug fixed (for Kokoro Bad End)  
 - Wrong uniform display in Inori route fixed.  
 - Minor text errors fixed.  
  
3. Issues:  
 - Saving bug (caused by permissions) will not be fixed by this patch as it is part of the installer. Do not move the game folder in your program files directory or Windows may prevent the game from creating save data. If you still have problems saving, move the game folder to your root directory(C:\\Shiny Days) or another local disk.  
 - Game stability and crash problems relating to engine anomalies and driver disagreements have not been changed. The game engine is a little fragile, so playing on high speed for extended periods of time, or skipping many scenes in a row will likely overload the engine and cause a crash. The only workaround so far is to save often and use the skip function to move forward. I tried waiting a bit before every skip and there were no crashes so far.  
 - If the game has no sound, try deleting the config.dat and restarting the game will fix this problem.  
 - If the game does not run properly in fullscreen mode (showing a black screen):  
Setting the compatibility mode to Window 7 or XP will fix this. Disabling dpi scaling in the shortcut properties also helps in some cases. If the fullscreen is not properly scaled there may also be graphics card specific settings to change. Multi display systems may also have trouble running the game in full screen. Moving the game in windowed mode between windows while video is playing also has a high chance of the game crashing.
